rules.usav_summary: USA Volleyball 2025-2027 rules: Jewelry (studs/small hoops) is allowed during play; a re-serve is permitted for a tossing error (once per service turn); Libero is allowed to be captain; net contact is a fault when touching net between antennae during play.
rules.srva_summary: SRVA requires all athletes and staff to be registered via SRVAonline. Athletes must accept Mid TN VBC as their club in the SRVA system to be eligible for tournaments. Medical Release form required.
rules.expert_info: We follow USA Volleyball and SRVA standards. Key areas: service order, Libero transitions, re-serve rules, and tournament eligibility via SRVA membership.

faqs.q: What is the cost of tryouts?
Where do I sign in for tryouts?
faqs.a: Check-in and sign-in occur at our main facility located at 6910 Stroop Ln, Smyrna, TN 37167 (Hooptown front desk). Please arrive 30 minutes early.

faqs.q: When will we know team placements?
faqs.a: Initial offers are typically sent out via email within 24-48 hours after the final tryout session for your age group.

faqs.q: What do I need to be ready for?
faqs.a: Athletes should bring water, knee pads, court shoes, and be ready for physical testing (height, reach, vertical) and agility drills (shuttle run) before moving into skill-based evaluations. Ensure SRVA membership and medical release forms are ready.
